author: reek
body: Bounded signatures, stage B: the runtime boundary guards do not false-trap on in-range values. inc-byte's bounded parameter is range-checked at the callee entry (Eiffel-style precondition) and 5 passes; clamp-ret's bounded return is range-checked before the epilogue (postcondition) and 9 passes. Both guards are emitted (the param guard unconditionally; the return guard because __narrow n is not statically provable in range - the __narrow takes lint responsibility now that CDX2051 is an error, and the emit-side guard still runs) and both are exercised here.
